description: What an EVM wallet already holds across the AtlasYield catalog, and how each holding is scored. Reads the balance of every catalog vault on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and BNB. positions: scored holdings with composite, pillar scores, yield quality, exit safety, routability and any open blowup-monitor alerts. unscored: catalog vaults held that carry no score (no Atlas number is given for them). valueUsd is an estimate. complete:false means a chain could not be read: treat that chain as unknown, never as empty. Solana (Kamino) is not read. Read-only.
name: get_wallet_positions
title: Get wallet positions
